create_range_dataset: create a Range dataset that iterates from a begin integer to an end integer
reset_range_iterator: reset the Range dataset iterator back to its initial begin value
iterate_range_values: iterate through a Range dataset yielding sequential integers from begin to end
save_range_state: save the current iteration state of a Range dataset as a state dictionary
load_range_state: load a previously saved state dictionary into a Range dataset to resume iteration
